notes: Categories are data. The app reads this list; users can add, edit, or archive entries. 'hints' are soft signals passed to the predictor alongside the description, not hard rules. 'keywords' mark a category when the merchant name contains one; 'require_keyword' means never suggest the category for an unknown merchant without a keyword match (transit vendors are a known set). Budget amounts here are examples; each user sets their own in the app (Categories screen).

categories.name: Fun
categories.description: Purchases at bars, social venues, restaurants, or stores that sell goods or services related to hobbies. Weekend purchases lean Fun. Bodega purchases are roughly 50/50 between Fun and Grocery/Food.

budget.week_rule: Each weekend belongs to the month its Saturday falls in. Week N covers the days after the previous weekend through the Nth weekend. Weekdays right after a weekend (Mon-Wed) and days after the month's last weekend are ambiguous: offer both weeks as buttons.

categories.name: Grocery/Food
categories.description: Purchases from grocery stores and bodegas. Restaurant purchases under $40 on a weekday are likely takeout and belong here.

categories.name: Transportation
categories.description: Any transaction with a transportation vendor, e.g. Uber, Lyft, MTA, Clipper, Citi Bike.

categories.name: Miscellaneous
categories.description: Purchases that don't clearly belong in any other fixed or variable category.

categories.name: Work Expenses
categories.description: Anything purchased for your job. Can overlap with any other category; decided by the user.

categories.name: Fitness
categories.description: Merchants providing health (not healthcare) services: gyms, pools, stretching studios, yoga, Pilates, bath houses. Includes fitness-hobby retailers such as bike or running stores.

categories.name: Shopping
categories.description: Non-grocery goods: clothes, cosmetics, hobby items, technology.

categories.name: Travel
categories.description: DRAFT: Costs of trips away from home: flights, hotels and other lodging, rental cars, long-distance trains and buses, and travel booking sites.

predict_modes.auto: Can be predicted and shown on notification buttons.
predict_modes.fallback_only: Never predicted from uncertainty. Shown as a button only when nothing else fits or the merchant history says so. Low confidence should prompt the user instead.
predict_modes.manual_only: Never predicted automatically; always reachable from the app. Predicted only once a merchant's own history shows it.
